name: Small Branch
flavor_text: A small branch, recently broken from a tree. Useful for kindling, crafting, or making something slightly more complicated than a stick.

name: Tree Core
flavor_text: A dense knot of natural energy harvested from a tree. It contains all the good stuff that makes trees do their whole growing into giant plants thing.

name: Pine Log
flavor_text: A freshly cut length of pine, light and easy to work with. It smells considerably better than most things adventurers drag back from the wilderness.

name: Arboreal Essence
flavor_text: A faintly green essence drawn from living trees. It carries the quiet strength of the forest, though it mostly just looks like glowing tree juice.

name: Berry Good Berries
flavor_text: A handful of perfectly ordinary berries. They're good berries. Really good berries. Possibly the berry-est berries you've ever seen.

name: Pinecone Branch
flavor_text: A crooked branch covered in pinecones. Waving it aggressively seems to convince the pinecones that they have somewhere else to be.

name: Bark Shield
flavor_text: A sturdy shield made from layered tree bark. Surprisingly tough, surprisingly light, and only slightly more comfortable than being hit by a tree.

name: Leaf Cloak
flavor_text: A cloak woven from leaves and forest growth. When worn, it seems to make the wearer blend into the surrounding forest as though they belong there.

name: Timber Axe
flavor_text: A heavy axe designed for one purpose: cutting down trees. It is exceptionally good at doing exactly that.

name: Thorn Boots
flavor_text: Boots covered in sturdy thorns that bite into bark with every step. Trees make excellent ladders when you don't mind climbing them.

name: Mossy Chest
flavor_text: A wooden-looking chestplate covered in soft green moss. It smells faintly of a forest floor after rain.

name: Thorn Ring
flavor_text: A small ring wrapped in living thorns. They seem to prick the air around them, as though constantly searching for something to grow into.

name: Boss Goblin Tooth
flavor_text: A large, surprisingly sturdy goblin tooth. It probably saw some use before ending up here.

name: Boss Goblin Bone
flavor_text: A goblin bone, somewhat larger and denser than usual. Perfectly good for whatever someone might need a goblin bone for.

name: Boss Goblin Core
flavor_text: A dense core of concentrated goblin energy. It contains all the good stuff that makes goblins do their whole being obnoxious little monsters thing.

name: Boss Goblin Blood
flavor_text: Goblin blood. It's thicker than you'd expect, and smells considerably worse than you'd hope.

name: Coin Pouch
flavor_text: A small pouch of coins. How much is in it? Well, that's the fun part.

name: Skull Helm
flavor_text: A battered helmet crowned with the skull of a goblin. Whether the skull belonged to a former enemy, former ally, or former owner is probably best left unanswered.

name: Sneaky Dagger
flavor_text: A small, unassuming dagger with a wickedly narrow blade. It isn't much to look at until someone stops paying attention to where you're standing.

name: Goblin Belt
flavor_text: A belt covered in little hooks, loops, pouches, and suspiciously specific tools. Nobody knows what half of them are for, but a goblin would probably insist they're all essential.

name: Patchwork Armor
flavor_text: Leather armor assembled from whatever scraps happened to be available. No two pieces quite match, but somehow the whole mess holds together.

name: Goblin Trap
flavor_text: An elaborate contraption of ropes, sticks, pulleys, tripwires, counterweights, and several parts that appear to serve no purpose whatsoever. It is either an ingenious trap or a pile of garbage. Probably both.

name: Boss Goblin Brew
flavor_text: A foul-smelling brew kept in a battered bottle. It tastes like someone dissolved a campfire in stale beer, but it seems to put some extra muscle behind whoever drinks it.

name: Boss Goblin Elixir
flavor_text: A strange greenish liquid in a tiny bottle. It tastes absolutely terrible, but somehow leaves the drinker feeling lighter, quicker, and considerably more awake.

name: Boss Goblin Bow
flavor_text: A crude-looking goblin bow reinforced with scraps of metal and bone. The arrows it fires seem to hit just a little harder than they have any right to. There's probably something magical going on here. Probably.

name: Boss Totem
flavor_text: A crude wooden totem covered in goblin carvings. When planted, it seems to draw the attention of anything nearby while making those around it strangely difficult to hurt. Goblins apparently discovered that the best defense is making yourself everyone else's problem.
